headline: Roper Technologies to present at Oppenheimer Technology Conference
summary: SARASOTA, Fla., Aug. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Roper Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROP) announced that it is presenting at the Oppenheimer 29th Annual Technology, Internet & Communications Conference on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 9:55 AM (Eastern Time). A link to the webcast presentation will be available in the “Investors” section of the Company’s website at www.ropertech.com.
